description: Top-level integrity and provenance index for the workflow input families.
chain: Each family index records the sha256 of every file it lists; this index records the sha256 of each family index. scripts/check-dataset-indexes.py fails on any recorded hash mismatch, on any file present under datasets/ that no index lists, and on any tracked-but-unlisted file.

families.description: Classic Pegasus DAX inputs (Bharathi et al. 2008 characterization), DAX 2.1/3.3 XML.
families.retained_in_standard_checkout: All 22 files: 20 instances plus the HEFT paper example and the preserved pre-fix Epigenomics_997 original.
families.boundary: Synthetic characterization workflows; the paper example is not counted among the 20 instances.

families.description: WfCommons WfGen synthetic instances (WfFormat JSON) with generation manifests.
families.retained_in_standard_checkout: 1 of 42 instance JSONs (montage/n100/montage-100-000.json); its generation manifest and the remaining instances are prepared separately.
families.boundary: Structures, runtimes, and file sizes come from learned distributions, not raw observations of a production execution; this corpus must not be mixed with real-execution-derived inputs into one workload population.

families.description: WfInstances v1.5 WfFormat JSON derived from real executions.
families.retained_in_standard_checkout: 4 of 180 inputs; the remaining corpus is prepared separately.
families.boundary: Derived from real executions, but not a source-platform trace replay: source machines, core counts, memory, commands, timestamps, and observed makespan are not replayed automatically. Structure validation of the snapshot does not imply that every input passes the standard simulation pipeline.

families.description: WfCommons 1.6 WfGen synthetic standard-workloads corpus (WfFormat JSON), regenerable byte-identically from experiments/studies/standard-workloads/spec.json.
families.retained_in_standard_checkout: 200 of 360 instance JSONs (every n50 and n100 instance) plus GENERATION.json; the n1000 instances are regenerated with the generator.
families.boundary: WfGen synthetic instances generated by WfCommons 1.6 recipes: structures, runtimes, and file sizes are sampled from distributions learned from historical executions; they are not traces of a production execution and must not be mixed with real-execution-derived (WfInstances) or classic DAX inputs into one workload population.
